description: For window cleaning, this inspection checklist records scheduled interior and exterior work, recurring exclusions, stain treatment, ladder limits, crew, and approved add-ons. Its supporting evidence includes pane completion counts, condition changes, screen tracking, weather, access exceptions, photos, and quality recheck.

items: Scheduled interior and exterior panes are reconciled
Glass is checked for streaks, residue, and missed edges
Screens, tracks, sills, and requested detail work are complete
Pre-existing cracks, failed seals, frames, and hardware are recorded
Inaccessible or weather-deferred panes have a reason
Access points, furnishings, floors, and property security are restored

use_case: Use the inspection checklist during window cleaning account service record when the window cleaning record must identify property account, pane inventory, service cycle, access methods, known defects, screen locations, and customer preferences. Complete the applicable handoff for inventory update, missed-pane recovery, secure-access confirmation, customer quality check, and next-cycle planning.
